item.text: To book a room, first submit the dates and times you would like to use it. We will then check whether the room is available and let you know that we received your request. Please note that this confirmation only means we have received your booking request—it does not mean the room has been approved or reserved. Your booking is confirmed only after we have checked availability and given you formal approval.
